research_question: Can a deterministic ICT Classic Buy/Sell Week lifecycle—early-week accumulation, next-day Judas raid, completed hourly CISD and later-week liquidity delivery—produce repeatable Bybit after-cost NAV growth?
smc_ict_explanation: Monday or Monday-Tuesday creates the weekly accumulation range. The following manipulation day must sweep one extreme. A completed one-hour candle must reclaim the range and close through the open of the last opposite-colour hourly candle. Entry is the next five-minute open, stop is beyond the Judas extreme and target is opposite early-week liquidity or prior-week external liquidity.

not_used: FVG, IFVG, BPR or OTE entry

data_contract.development_period: 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31, downloaded only after fit survivors are frozen
data_contract.gap_contract: Complete UTC five-minute grid; no accumulation range, hourly confirmation, entry or open position may bridge a missing bar. A position encountering a source gap receives its structural stop outcome.

weekly_contract.accumulation: the first one or two complete UTC calendar days, fixed by policy
weekly_contract.manipulation: the immediately following complete UTC calendar day only
weekly_contract.sweep: hourly high/low extends beyond the accumulation boundary by the policy ATR multiple
weekly_contract.intrabar_ambiguity: if the same completed hour sweeps both accumulation extremes, the week is rejected
weekly_contract.cisd: last opposite-colour completed hourly candle open, frozen strictly before the sweep
weekly_contract.confirmation: within three or six hours after the sweep, a completed hourly displacement reclaims the accumulation range and closes through CISD
weekly_contract.entry: the five-minute open exactly at the confirmation-hour close
weekly_contract.stop: actual Judas extreme plus 0.05 hourly ATR
weekly_contract.target: opposite accumulation boundary or prior-week external high/low, fixed by policy
weekly_contract.position_exit: structural stop, frozen target or source-gap structural-stop outcome only; no elapsed-time or Friday exit
weekly_contract.period_boundary: unresolved positions are marked and cannot pass the gate; they are never force-closed

development_rule: Freeze at most six highest 18bps fit-growth survivors, recording IDs and the fit-grid hash before any 2023 download. Apply identical rules and gates.
promotion_boundary: This discovery sequence cannot rank. Any development survivor requires a new actual-funding exact-BBO 2024-2026 sequential claim.
